label: early original token right after a 1, in a context of s/d/n/w/k/1
explanation: Fires in the original phase at position 2 or 3 (about 89% of mass) when the previous input was the digit 1 (87% of mass, lift 31x). Within that context it is selective: the current token is most often e, h, d, 1, s, i, q or j (rarely a), and the earlier prefix contains s, d, n, w, k or another 1 (for example s s 1 e, d s 1 e, d 1 1 1). The strongest activations are on prefixes like d s 1 / s s 1 / d 1 1 followed by e, h, d or 1. prev_tok==1 at t in {2,3} by itself has recall 0.83 but precision 0.05. Adding the current-token and prefix-token sets raises dev F1 to 0.55 (mass recall 0.74). The feature looks like a lookup over three-token combinations, which the token sets only approximate. It almost never fires at t<2, at the delimiter, or in the copy phase (7% of mass, scattered and weak).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=2 & prev_tok=1 (+5.65), t=3 & prev_tok=1 (+4.20), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=e (+3.81), prev2_tok=1 (+3.79), phase=2 & in_tok=i (+3.49), in_tok=h (+3.27). Lower it: correct=1 (-6.24), prev2_tok=i (-2.45), orig0=e (-2.38).
